Exactly two red beads are incorrectly raised next to cap leaves/upper temple, and whole coil hangs beside high side head instead of low-nape to shoulder-front attachment. Same-gray returns improve and lower gray C is visible, but geometry/flatness not certified; smooth bob/cloth volume shading remains. Wider guide is extent evidence, not original-cel/camera/temporal equivalence. Fresh independent review pending; no acceptance.
